### Description

2. enable multi-gpu training with resume_from_checkpoint, identified an issue with bnb-related optimizers
3. readme updates reflecting the updates

## Pull Request Overview

This PR adds scheduler alignment and multi-GPU support for the HuggingFace LLM example, addressing key issues with iterative training when using complex learning rate schedulers. The changes enable proper scheduler alignment by replacing epoch incrementing with HF callback functions and support multi-GPU training with resume_from_checkpoint functionality.

- Added scheduler alignment using HuggingFace TrainerCallback to maintain consistent learning rate schedules across iterative training rounds
- Implemented multi-GPU training support with distributed training setup and proper checkpoint handling
- Updated existing training scripts to use consistent optimizers and added configurable learning rate scheduler support

## Pull Request Overview

This PR enhances the HuggingFace LLM example with scheduler alignment and multi-GPU support. The main purpose is to improve the federated learning capabilities by addressing scheduler misalignment issues in iterative training and enabling multi-GPU training scenarios.

- Added scheduler alignment using HuggingFace callback functions instead of manual epoch incrementing
- Implemented multi-GPU training support with distributed training utilities and proper device management
- Updated documentation to reflect the new capabilities and provide usage examples
